class.name: ChorusInferenceRequest
class.brief_description: Base resource for generation and embedding input.
class.description: Shared input and scheduling fields for [ChorusRequest] and [ChorusEmbeddingRequest]. Submit a concrete subclass through [GodotChorus]. Admission copies these values; later changes to the resource do not alter accepted work.

members.member: Text to generate from or embed. For sessioned generation, this becomes the new user message. Regeneration requires empty content.
Conversation identity for generation, or a correlation and occupancy key for embeddings. An empty name selects stateless work, which does not read or write conversation history.
Scheduling priority. Higher values take precedence when the provider chooses queued work; this does not preempt a running request. Must fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Scheduling mode for this request. See [enum ChorusExecution.Value].
